title: TymusClient
description: Lightweight Fabric utility mod for 1.20.1 —  Equipment saver
body:
TymusClient is a client-side utility mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 on Fabric, built for players who want real control over their gameplay — gear saving and more — all in one place, with no server install required.

Whether you're grinding repetitive tasks, competing in PvP, or just want quality-of-life tools that don't slow down your game, TymusClient has you covered.

---



## 🛡️ Equipment Saver

Save your full gear loadout and restore it instantly with a keybind. No more manually re-equipping after death or switching between builds by hand.

---

## 📊 HUD Overlay

A minimal, always-visible overlay keeps you informed without cluttering your screen:

- Live **FPS** counter

---

## 📥 Installation

TymusClient requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**. Once you have those installed, drop the TymusClient `.jar` into your `mods` folder and launch the game as normal.

Press **F9** in-game to open the GUI. Use **,** and **.** to switch between tabs.

> Client-side only — works on any server without any server-side setup.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

TymusClient saves your settings automatically to `.minecraft/config/tymus_client.json`. You can edit it directly, or change keybinds under **Options → Controls → TymusClient**.


```
